title: Cartographer
description: A procedural fantasy-atlas studio: plate tectonics, orographic rain, river hydrology & lakes, Whittaker biomes, and a real Köppen–Geiger climate model driven by latitude, altitude, hemisphere and continentality. It names the great rivers by tracing their main stems, grows a resource economy of grain, ore, wine and furs with trade-weighted roads, and writes a deterministic chronicle of foundings, wars, eruptions, floods and golden ages. Thematic overlays turn it into an atlas of climate, resources, temperature, rainfall and elevation — restylable across five palettes (including a luminous Nocturne night-map), inspectable cell by cell, and exportable to PNG or SVG.
